units.source_text: 他认清了一个新的事实：他把话题转移的后果，以抨击变节的故友为基础，他们的忠义行为受到了更多的赞扬。

en.t: He came to recognize a new fact: by shifting the subject and making an attack on his former friends who had defected its basis, their own acts of loyalty won even greater praise.

units.source_text: 因此，吹拂在他心里的春风，再一次带走了几分温暖。

en.t: Because of that, the spring breeze blowing through his heart once again carried away a little of its warmth.

units.source_text: 诚然，他不光是为了转移话题才痛惜那些背叛者、

en.t: To be sure, he did not grieve over those betrayers merely in order to change the subject,

units.source_text: 事实上，他对他们临阵脱逃的行为不禁觉得痛惜，也感到十分难过。

en.t: In fact, he could not help feeling regret over their flight in the face of battle, and he felt deeply distressed by it as well.

units.source_text: 但是他虽然为那些不忠的务武士感到惋惜，但是却并不真的憎恨他们。

en.t: But although he felt pity for those disloyal warriors, he did not truly hate them.

units.source_text: 假如能够用率直这个词，那很是率直的可怜。

en.t: If the word frank can be used, then it was a very frank sort of pity.

units.source_text: 就因为总这样，他其实一直对他们持有包容的态度，

en.t: Precisely because he was always like this, he had in truth maintained a tolerant attitude toward them all along,

units.source_text: 更遑论在大仇得报的今天，对他们也只有可怜的一笑置之罢了。

en.t: and all the more so today, when his great vengeance had been fulfilled, he could only dismiss them with a pitying smile.

units.source_text: 社会上的百姓好像都认为就算杀了他们也难消心头之恨。

en.t: The people of society seemed to think that even killing them would not be enough to dispel the hatred in their hearts.

units.source_text: 难道将我们捧作忠臣，就一定要贬低他们为衣冠禽兽呢？

en.t: Must praising us as loyal retainers necessarily mean lowering them into beasts dressed in human clothes?

units.source_text: 我们和他们之间并没有什么难以逾越的鸿沟。

en.t: There is no unbridgeable gulf between us and them.

units.source_text: 内藏助对江户百姓受到的奇妙影响早就产生了厌恶心理。

en.t: Kuranosuke had long since come to feel disgust at the strange influence that had taken hold of the common people of Edo.

units.source_text: 如今他又在以传右卫门为代表的舆论中看到了这次临阵脱逃的人所受到的影响。

en.t: Now, in the public opinion represented by Denemon, he again saw the influence that had affected those who had fled in this incident.

units.source_text: 虽然说这两件事本质不同，但是也不能怪他感到不快了。

en.t: Although these two matters were essentially different, one could hardly blame him for feeling displeased.
